reviews.comment: Dr. Wyatt was super easy on grading and allowed students to turn in work past due dates without deducting points. However, his in-class lectures felt like I was sitting in a TED Talk or podcast episode. Many of his lectures had nothing to do with class; instead, he would rant about almost everything but what the class was about.

Dr. Wyatt is a good choice for ENGL 210. He is accessible outside of class, very straightforward, and sets clear guidelines for assignments. He also has a regrading policy up until the group project to improve your grade. Do all the work and you will do well in the course, just make sure to follow the rubrics for assignments.

I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR!! Despite a few challenging assignments, he provides thorough feedback and multiple opportunities for improvement. He's always accessible, offers advice beyond coursework. Overall, a FANTASTIC professor and even better person. I looked forward to every class. Best English prof I have EVER had - I highly recommend him!!!

Professor Wyatt is an amazing person. He is knowledgeable, relatable, and cares deeply about his students' well-being. He is not afraid to tell you the harsh truth; he only wants to help you. He allows you to redo work and submit it late and always provides good feedback. You can learn so much from him. I would love another class with him.

This is the best English professor I've ever had. Although some assignments were difficult, he gave each student feedback and many chances to change their work to his standards. Available outside of class time, and can even advise about non-class problems. Overall great professor and a great guy, I recommend him.
